First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 5:30 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Chill flow to intermediate, 8-mile loops.
Check

About the MMB Thursday Ride group ride

MMB Thursday Ride is a mountain bike group ride in Colorado Springs, CO. It rolls every Thursday at 5:30 pm from Varies weekly; Oct 1 start is Pineries Open Space.

A Thursday-evening mountain bike ride from Monument Mountain Bikers. Oct 1 was an 8-mile smooth, flowy loop at the Pineries with a tailgate after; Oct 8 is an intermediate 8-mile loop at Sandstone Ranch. Chairs and a post-ride beverage are part of it.
